titulo: Extract calibration · 90° / 680 nm · selected linear model
pie_ingles: Linear extract calibration selected by Alex on 20 November 2026. (A) Mean net intensities and their acquisition SD, with the global concentration-on-signal fit including the measured zero-reference blank. (B) Leave-one-sample-out concentration predictions. (C) Signed relative errors. (D) MAPE in five groups of four reference levels. Each held-out unit is a complete sample; the session blank remains available. Residual structure persists.
Measured 680 nm intensities and normalized responses with and without kaolin. The 810 nm correction is exploratory. Response percentages are not concentration recoveries.

Medium-subtracted 680 nm response from ten recorded relative AO culture levels at 90° under 430 nm excitation. Linear and logarithmic horizontal axes show the same means and acquisition SD. The medium blank is fixed. Chlorophyll concentrations of the cultures were not determined independently; the horizontal axis has no absolute concentration unit.

titulo: Selected linear calibration · full range and low-end enlargement
pie_ingles: The same global linear calibration is shown over the full measured range and enlarged at the low end. Gray points include the measured zero-reference blank. Horizontal error bars show acquisition SD. The enlargement is not a locally refitted line. The freely fitted intercept is negative.

Full-fit and held-out concentration errors are distinguished. The lower-right panel follows sample identifiers and does not establish measurement chronology. Local bias persists; a near-zero global average must not be interpreted as absence of bias. Shared references and the session blank limit independence assumptions.

titulo: Selected line · errors in five concentration regions
pie_ingles: Internal held-out errors of the selected line in five groups of four consecutive references: MAPE, RMSE and mean signed bias. The blank is excluded from relative errors. Bars summarize observed errors and are not uncertainty intervals.

titulo: Selected line and historical quadratic · transparent model comparison
pie_ingles: The selected line is compared with the previously studied quadratic on the same references and held-out splits. Selection of the line is an explicit operational choice, not a claim that it minimizes RMSE. Both retain structured errors.

titulo: Reading repeatability does not represent total calibration error
pie_ingles: Variation among three acquisitions is mapped to the concentration scale using the fixed slope and contrasted with held-out prediction errors. These are distinct quantities: acquisition SD is not uncertainty of the sample mean or a prediction interval. Relative SD is divided by the assigned reference.

titulo: AO · signed outputs of the selected linear calibration
pie_ingles: Exploratory application of the selected extract line to AO using its session-medium blank. Nine mean outputs are negative and all ten lie below 0.15 µg/mL. Negative values are retained; they are model estimates, not physical negative concentrations. The zero crossing is a property of the line and is not a detection limit. Error bars describe acquisition SD with fixed blank and coefficients.

titulo: AO · all 18 channels · all ten culture levels
pie_ingles: Original and medium-subtracted channel spectra for all ten AO levels at 90°. Colors and markers distinguish levels in both panels. Signed logarithmic axes preserve negative differences. The 485 nm band is flagged as unstable and is retained for traceability; 680 nm is the selected analysis channel.

titulo: 680 nm reference readings · calibration and AO sessions
pie_ingles: Ten internal readings from each of three blank files in the extract-calibration and AO-medium datasets. Dotted lines indicate the session means used in subtraction. These files do not represent thirty independent blank preparations and do not establish a method LOD or LOQ.

titulo: Between-series response comparison at nominal 3 µg/mL
pie_ingles: The highest extract reference of the calibration series and pure extract of the kaolin series have the same nominal concentration but different net responses. Fixed-line outputs are shown as a transfer sensitivity check. The differences do not identify a cause or establish independently measured concentration recovery.

titulo: Kaolin series · selected 90° / 680 nm line applied without refitting
pie_ingles: Measured net responses and corresponding fixed-line equivalent estimates for all six kaolin-series preparations at 90°. Negative outputs for controls are retained. These are transfer calculations, not validated concentration recoveries; the nominal chlorophyll-containing preparations were supplied at 3 µg/mL. Acquisition SD holds the ethanol reference and slope fixed.
Red-channel signals and matched contrasts across kaolin loadings. Contrasts show measured response differences and do not isolate pure chlorophyll fluorescence.

titulo: Kaolin · all wavelengths, original and blank-subtracted
pie_ingles: All six preparations and 18 channels, with 90° on the left and 180° on the right. Original spectra are above and ethanol-subtracted spectra below. Flagged bands remain visible. Signed logarithmic scaling is identified on the figure.
Individual channel responses at 90° for preparations with and without extract. The unstable 485 nm band is flagged; acquisitions are technical replicates.
Individual channel responses at 180°. Near-2^32 readings at 410/435 nm and the unstable 485 nm band are flagged and excluded from interpretation.
Observed 18-channel responses across the extract references at 90°. This measurement overview does not make other channel fits the selected calibration.
Observed 18-channel responses across the extract references at 180°. Flagged channels remain documented. The current selected geometry is 90°.
